scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db && docker compose run --rm migrate
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db && docker compose run --rm migrate
scripts.test: DATABASE_URL= OWNER_DATABASE_URL= TRAFFIC_OBSERVE_SEC=30 PLAN_ACKS= TENANT_MAX_ACTIVE= SPEC_MIN_CONFIDENCE= REAL_STS=0 VERIFY_CRON= API_REAPER= ROLLBACK_WINDOW_SEC= MOCK_SEED=1 FAKE_LLM=1 MOCK_PRECHECK=1 DEV_AUTH=1 AUTH_SCRYPT_N=16384 MOCK_IAC=1 MOCK_ARGO=1 node --import tsx --test --test-timeout=60000 packages/*/test/*.test.ts apps/*/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:db: TRAFFIC_OBSERVE_SEC=30 PLAN_ACKS= TENANT_MAX_ACTIVE= SPEC_MIN_CONFIDENCE= REAL_STS=0 VERIFY_CRON= API_REAPER= ROLLBACK_WINDOW_SEC= MOCK_SEED=1 FAKE_LLM=1 MOCK_PRECHECK=1 DEV_AUTH=1 AUTH_SCRYPT_N=16384 MOCK_IAC=1 MOCK_ARGO=1 GITOPS_DISABLE=1 GITOPS_REPO_URL= GITOPS_REPO_DIR= GITOPS_PUSH=0 PROM_URL= TEST_DB_ISOLATE=1 sh -c 'node --env-file=.env tools/test/db-test-db.mjs setup || exit 1; node --env-file=.env --import tsx --import ./tools/test/db-isolate.mjs --test --test-concurrency=${TEST_DB_CONCURRENCY:-4} --test-timeout=120000 apps/*/test/*.it.ts packages/*/test/*.db.test.ts apps/*/test/*.db.test.ts; s=$?; node --env-file=.env tools/test/db-test-db.mjs cleanup; exit $s'
